theorem_title: The reporting base lies inside the source allocation
natural_language_statement:
Let an encoded-color pipeline output be stored with its original input, selected coloring, and strictly normalized witnesses $A,B,C$, at positive size $n$. For every natural supplied magnitude $U$, $$\operatorname{reportBase}\le\mathrm{free}+\operatorname{sourceNeed}(n,U)_{\mathrm{cells}}.$$

Places the next reporting stage within the affine source-allocation envelope. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
